checkpoint.description: Mid-fight savestate captured immediately after a user-observed flash knockdown: the opponent went directly down without the usual visible stunned/wobble phase.

private_artifact.policy: Hashes only. Savestate and extracted RAM remain outside Git.

observation.important_boundary: The savestate proves the exact runtime snapshot exists, but without a matched ordinary stun-then-knockdown comparator it does not yet identify the internal branch condition, state field, damage threshold, animation selector, or responsible function.

overhaul_relevance.reason: The current Alpha 1 damage layer models knockdown as requiring an already-stunned state. Retail runtime behavior demonstrates at least one visible pathway where a boxer can be knocked down without first entering the normal visible stun/wobble phase. Therefore the overhaul should not hard-code 'visible stun must precede every knockdown' as a retail-derived invariant.

runtime_context.note: These persistent values are context/control only. They are not claimed to cause the flash knockdown.

next_best_comparator.capture: An ordinary knockdown in the same retail build where the opponent visibly enters the normal stunned/wobble phase first.
next_best_comparator.reason: A matched ordinary-knockdown snapshot gives a direct transient-state comparison against checkpoint 10 and may isolate branch/state differences in the fight-session or boxer runtime objects.
next_best_comparator.do_not_force: Do not waste career progression or repeated savestates trying to manufacture it. Capture it opportunistically when it occurs.
